name: revid
description: Research what goes viral, make finished short-form videos (voice, captions, music, AI footage) and post them to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and X.

interface.shortDescription: Research, make and post short videos
defaultPrompt: Find what is going viral about productivity apps this week and make a 30 second video from the strongest hook.
Turn https://www.revid.ai/blog/best-video-mcp-servers into a 45 second vertical video with captions and music.
Schedule my latest Revid video on my TikTok for Friday 6pm with a caption and 4 hashtags.
interface.longDescription:
Revid gives Codex the whole short-form video loop through the hosted Revid MCP server (30 tools). Search viral videos across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and X for hooks and formats, render a finished video with voice, captions, music and AI footage from a prompt, script, article or upload, then publish or schedule it to your connected accounts.

Sign in with your Revid account through OAuth. Searches are free; renders use Revid credits, and calculate_credits prices a render before you start it. The skills cover each workflow step by step, from research-make-and-post to product ads and talking-head videos.
